environment: QA2 collector read-only source snapshot; parser evaluated locally

sample.selection: random, up to 200 messages per source

segments.unit: parsed segment, not source message or HTTP attempt

contact_observations.interpretation: diagnostic counts only; not contact extraction recall or precision

active_core_fields.unit: active segment after candidate core-field review gate

limitations: No independent human labels; precision and recall are not measured.
The 17 sampled source labels were not reconciled against the full configured source list.
The small active vehicle count does not distinguish low source supply from classifier misses.
Attachments without text were not separately measured.
API persistence, active feed visibility, client rendering, and physical devices were not verified by this snapshot.
Active, review, and closed counts are segments and must not be compared directly with source-message totals.
